title: Rent Increase Notices and the Rent of Advance-Paid Months (Assisted Living)
content:
The rent of the coming months covered by an Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement advance payment follows any written rent increase notice recorded on the residency with its proposed rent. The **lead** is the calendar days from the mailing date of the notice to the first day of the coming month, that is the first day after the most recent billed month.

| Lead | Rent of the coming months |
|---|---|
| 60 days or more | Every coming month at the proposed rent of the notice |
| Shorter than 60 days but no shorter than 60 less 31, that is 29 days | The first coming month at the contracted monthly rent, every later coming month at the proposed rent |

Any shorter lead, or a residency with no pending notice, falls outside this note.

### Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical: June is the most recent billed month, so the first coming month starts 1 July)

| Notice mailed | Lead to 1 July | Rent of the coming months |
|---|---|---|
| 2 May | 60 | All at the proposed rent |
| 3 May | 59 | July at the contracted rent; later months at the proposed rent |
| 2 June | 29 | July at the contracted rent; later months at the proposed rent |
| 3 June | 28 | Outside this note |

Illustration: two coming months, contracted rent 4285.00, proposed rent 4500.00, lead 45 days: 4285.00 plus 4500.00, that is 8785.00 of rent.
